title: Alqueva irrigation area, Beja - Ferreira do Alentejo (Portugal): summer NDVI change 2018-2025
description: 10 x 10 km public study area inside the Alqueva multipurpose irrigation scheme, south-west of Beja. Bounding box only; no farm or parcel boundaries are used.
selection_rationale: AOI = 10 km block with the largest share of summer NDVI increase > 0.2 in a coarse (160 m) tile-wide screening of 29SNC, 2018-08-18 vs 2024-08-21 (see screening_29SNC.json). It is a change hotspot chosen on purpose and is not representative of Alentejo. Dates: peak-summer window, relative orbit 037, scene cloud < 1 %, processing baseline 05.xx on both dates, date closest to mid-August.
